message.content:
The query counts how many documents are associated with each template type code.

FINAL SQL:
```sql
SELECT
    rt.Template_Type_Code,
    COUNT(D.Document_ID) AS count_of_documents
FROM
    Ref_Template_Types rt
LEFT JOIN
    Templates t ON rt.Template_Type_Code = t.Template_Type_Code
LEFT JOIN
    Documents d ON t.Template_ID = d.Template_ID
GROUP BY
    rt.Template_Type_Code;
```
